response.overview: Ruth Harkness inherits the Flying W Ranch and journeys west with her sheltered Eastern relatives and fashionable fiancé. But life on the frontier proves far more dangerous than they imagined when a pair of scheming cowboys set their sights on her inheritance. Fortunately, Rex Randerson, a fearless, easygoing ranger, is on hand to protect Ruth and foil their plans. As danger mounts and romance blossoms, Ruth discovers that the West holds more adventure—and a little more excitement—than she ever expected.
response.title: The Range Boss
